definitions.explanation: At whatever time; without restriction on timing.

examples.japanese: いつでも{遊|あそ}びに{来|き}てください。
{彼|かれ}はいつでも{元気|げんき}だ。
いつでも{連絡|れんらく}してね。

notes:
USAGE: いつでも indicates freedom of timing (anytime) or constancy (always). It combines いつ (when) + でも (even).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・いつでも + verb (anytime, you can ~)
・いつでも + adjective (always ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・いつでも - anytime, always
・いつも - always, usually
・どこでも - anywhere
・だれでも - anyone
・なんでも - anything

CONTRAST:
・いつでも - anytime (flexible), always (constant)
・いつも - always, usually (habitual)
